context_for_next_testing_agent: Reset Password functionality fully tested and working in preview environment. The issue was that production deployments redirect /reset-password to / because server doesn't know about client-side routes. Fix added three SPA routing config files: 1) /app/frontend/public/_redirects (Netlify/general), 2) /app/frontend/vercel.json (Vercel), 3) /app/frontend/public/staticwebapp.config.json (Azure). These files tell the server to serve index.html for all routes except /api/* and static assets. Backend FRONTEND_URL=https://routemail.co ensures reset emails contain correct production URL. Production verification requires deployment.

forgot_password_endpoint.functionality: Sends password reset email with link using FRONTEND_URL

reset_password_endpoint.functionality: Accepts token and new password, validates, updates password, invalidates sessions

reset_password_component.functionality: Displays reset form when token present, error when no token

spa_routing_config.purpose: Ensure server serves index.html for client-side routes in production

production_verification_note: Preview environment routes work correctly because the preview server is configured for SPA routing. Production fix requires the hosting platform to read the appropriate config file (_redirects for Netlify, vercel.json for Vercel, or staticwebapp.config.json for Azure). If production still redirects to /, verify which hosting platform is used and ensure the correct config file is deployed to the build output.
